title: build(deps): bump zod from 4.6.2 to 4.6.5
intent: Routine Dependabot currency, no advisory. zod 4.6.2 -> 4.6.5 in packages/client -- three patch releases, a FORWARD move within zod 4 (the opposite direction to PR #296's silent 4 -> 3 revert). 4.6.3 removes the standalone z.properties() schema added in 4.6.0 (z.instanceof().properties() and .check(z.properties()) unchanged); 4.6.4 adds z.currencyCode() and reimplements z.url() rejection with URL.canParse(); 4.6.5 keys the z.instanceof().properties() shape off the instance type, plus docs. Authored by hand because Dependabot cannot author a manifest (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001); the payload of that friction is the lockfile audit in behavior_change.
behavior_change: none in the shipped app. Lockfile audited against merge base 7f039283 (= origin/main at audit time) by parsing both package-lock.json trees and comparing every `packages` entry in full, not by reading the diff view. Entry count is 412 before and 412 after. Exactly 1 node_modules entry changed: zod 4.6.2 -> 4.6.5 (forward), changing only version, resolved and integrity; its own dependency map is unchanged. Zero packages added, zero removed, no other entry touched. The root entry differs in one key, dependencies.zod ^4.6.2 -> ^4.6.5. Consumer analysis: zod has exactly one importer in packages/client/src, cam/compare/compare_types.ts, and it is unreachable from src/main.ts in a static+dynamic import-graph walk, so no shipped code path validates with zod today. Independently, that file uses none of the APIs these releases change (.properties(), z.url(), z.instanceof, z.currencyCode -> 0 uses), so the bump would be behaviour-neutral even if that module were mounted.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves the single declared range for zod from ^4.6.2 to ^4.6.5 -- one line, no other dependency touched. package-lock.json resolves it: zod 4.6.2 -> 4.6.5. No incidental version movement; the added, removed and non-zod changed sets are all empty.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency, stated plainly. No existing manifest covers this diff; the prior zod-4.6.2-bump manifest and other dependency manifests would each cover these two files, and borrowing one is what CBSP21-NOBORROW-001 refuses.
